fleetImport.intro: Add this client's machines, and fit their loggers, from an Excel workbook. Download the template, fill the Equipment sheet (and the Devices sheet to fit loggers), then choose the file to see what would change. Nothing is written until you apply, existing machines are never changed, and loggers must already be assigned to this client.
